text.aria-label: Title text 'Change in the copied share of an injected lag shift, 8 folds (2025-11 to 2026-06) Copied share: the slope of the median forecast's change on the shift, 1 means a full copy. Below 0 is better for the first arm. Dot: estimate. Thick line: 98.33% bootstrap interval. Thin line: 98.33% t interval. Dashed line: no change.'
text.tspan: Change in the copied share of an injected lag shift, 8 folds (2025-11 to 2026-06)
Copied share: the slope of the median forecast's change on the shift, 1 means a full copy. Below 0 is better for the
first arm. Dot: estimate. Thick line: 98.33% bootstrap interval. Thin line: 98.33% t interval. Dashed line: no change.
